body: An open-source framework for detecting, redacting, masking, and anonymizing sensitive data (PII) across text, images, and structured data. Supports NLP, pattern matching, and customizable pipelines.
plain_description: Presidio automatically detects and removes sensitive personal data (PII) from text and images, helping organizations meet data privacy compliance requirements. It works out of the box with built-in recognizers for credit card numbers, names, locations, and more, and can be customized for your specific needs. Deploy it in minutes via Python, Docker, or Kubernetes.
technical_description: Presidio is a modular Python framework for context-aware PII identification and de-identification in text and images. It provides an Analyzer leveraging Named Entity Recognition, regex patterns, rule-based logic, and checksum validation to detect sensitive entities, and an Anonymizer that applies redaction, masking, or replacement operators. The framework supports custom recognizers, external NLP model integration, and deployment as a containerized microservice via Docker or Kubernetes with PySpark support for distributed processing.
title: Presidio
